content: दानम् [दा-ल्युट्] .²1 Giving, granting, teaching, <ab>&c.</ab> (in general); giving in marriage (<ab>cf.</ab> कन्यादान). .²2 Delivering, handing over. .²3 A gift, donation, present; <ls>Ms. 2. 158</ls>; दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे <ls>Bg. 17. 20</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 274</ls>. .²4 Liberality, charity, giving away as charity, munificence; <ls>R. 1. 69</ls>; दानं भोगो नाशस्तिस्रो गतयो भवन्ति वित्तस्य <ls>Bh. 2. 43</ls>; दानं हि उत्सर्गपूर्वकः परस्य स्वत्वसम्बन्धः <ls>ŚB. on MS. 4. 1. 30</ls>; ननु दानमित्युच्यते स्वत्वनिवृत्तिः परस्वत्वापादनम् च . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 7. 1</ls>. .²5 Ichor or the juice that exudes from the temples of an elephant in rut; स दानतोयेन विषाणि नागः <ls>Śi. 4. 63</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 9</ls>; <ls>V. 4. 25</ls>; <ls>Pt. 2. 75</ls> (where the word has sense 4 also); <ls>R. 2. 7</ls>, <ls n="R.">4. 45</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 43</ls>. .²6 Bribery, as one of the four Upāyas or expedients of overcoming oneʼs enemy; see उपाय. .²7 Cutting, dividing .²8 Purification, cleaning. .²9 Protection. .²10 Pasture. .²11 Adding; addition. .{@-नः@} <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 Distribution (of food), meal, especially a sacrificial meal. .²2 Part, possession, share. .²3 A distributor.
